turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm going on vacation and I want to bring one book, but I can't decide which.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me get through all the options before you weigh in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One is a light romance set on an island, perfect for lying by the pool.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is a thick science fiction novel my brother keeps telling me to read.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could finally read that classic novel I've been pretending I read in school.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all of them. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The island romance fits the vacation mood perfectly, easy and relaxing. The science fiction one might be great if you'll have long flights or quiet evenings. The classic could feel like homework on a beach.
